description: This file defines the main page component for the food delivery frontend application, including a search bar, restaurant list, and shopping cart sidebar. It manages state for restaurant data and errors, performs search API calls, and renders the UI structure.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main component wrapping the inner content with the cart context provider.

methods.name: HomeInner
methods.description: Functional component managing restaurant search and display logic, including state for restaurants and errors, and performing the API call in useEffect.

methods.name: doSearch
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch restaurants based on search parameters, updating state with results or errors.
